router_detection: GET /models (optional ?reload=1): a missing or non-array data field throws 'llama.cpp returned an invalid model catalog' (client.ts lines 208-209); a data array containing any item without string id and string status.value throws 'Server is not running in llama.cpp router mode' (isModelInfo lines 56-60, list() lines 211-212)

models.failed_detection: entry.status.failed truthy (client.ts line 308); message uses status.exit_code when defined ('Model exited with code N', lines 309-312); status.value stays 'unloaded' on failure; an SSE event with data.status 'unloaded' also sets 'Model failed to load' (line 296)

load.success: any HTTP 2xx (response.ok, line 202); the body is parsed as JSON only for error text and {"success":true} is not checked (lines 227-229); non-2xx uses error.message from the JSON body or 'llama.cpp returned HTTP <status>'; the 15 s timeout applies to every request including this one (line 193)

unload.success: any HTTP 2xx (response.ok, line 202); unloadAndWait then polls GET /models every 100 ms until the entry is missing or status.value is 'unloaded' (lines 231-242)

polling.stop_condition: loadAndWait (lines 282-321) polls GET /models every 250 ms (line 315) until status.value is 'loaded' (line 306), or status.failed is truthy (line 308), or the caller's AbortSignal fires (line 304); there is no overall poll limit, only the 15 s per-request timeout (line 193); status.value 'unloaded' without failed keeps polling

other_endpoints_used.sse: GET /models/sse, SSE frames with JSON {model, event, data}; errors are ignored and polling stays authoritative (watch(), lines 248-280, comment line 274)
other_endpoints_used.props: REQUIRED for every loaded chat model: GET /props?model=<id>&autoload=false, reads models_autoload and chat_template (client.ts lines 216-225). provider.ts lines 268-275 await client.props({model}) inside Promise.all without a catch; only routerAutoloadEnabled catches props errors (lines 53-57). index.ts lines 54-62 rethrow from syncCatalog: a 404 makes /llama fail after a successful load (line 108), restoreLoaded in replace mode swaps back, and readCatalog shows the connection-error screen (lines 196-198). Owner decision needed before plan 2 phase F4: forward GET /props to the current upstream (recommended, real chat_template), or return HTTP 200 {} (pi treats the model as having no thinking support). provider.ts and index.ts references are reviewer-read evidence supplied in the fix-round-2 brief at source_sha, not locally read files

plan2_compatibility.architecture_input_modalities: Zero-filled architecture.input_modalities makes pi treat every model as text-only; plan 2 must account for the actual model modalities (owner-approved fix-round-2 brief)
plan2_compatibility.unknown_model_errors: Q2 is settled by spec section 9.4: host errors use section 9.6, not the router error format. pi reads only error.message from a non-2xx JSON body (client.ts lines 48-54); it does not depend on the router error code or type
